steps.content: Thorns blanket stone walls, prayers echo through Morveth Castle—separation, longing, and murmurs linger. A wish for reunion is made, and a lover returns from beyond the cycle of life and death; no matter their form, the wish is fulfilled. The night wind turns the pages of new vows. Dreams and reality converge, and obsession forges an unbreakable bond. Oh, ███ the soon-to-awaken, listen and bear witness. From the mist, new life emerges. The ghost bride arrives at the door, a new tale begins.
[Black Screen]
...Clack.
From the depths of your consciousness, you hear the clicking of high heels on stone tiles.
...Click... clack...
The sound draws closer to you.
At last, I've found you, my love.
Is the voice speaking to you?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I am...
You try to explain who you are, but the words catch in your throat, refusing to come out. You attempt to recall anything about yourself, but your mind is completely blank.
You are my destined other half. The one I've longed to meet in every dream and waking thought.
Our story is about to begin. My lifelong wish will finally be fulfilled.

Are you... really? The ethereal whispers drift around your ears, unfamiliar breath drawing near then fading away. A cold sensation grazes your fingertips, and your mind wavers, struggling to discern if it's real.
We will become lovers for all eternity, together in life and in death. We shall never be apart...
Never apart...
More and more voices close in on you, surrounding you from all sides. The mental contamination grows increasingly intense, suffocating you until you can barely breathe—
Never apart... Never apart!!!
You open your eyes. A dull pain throbs in your forehead, and your mind feels foggy—as if you've been struck with a blunt object. The persistent, heavy ache makes it difficult to think clearly.
Thunk! Your forehead hits straight into a wooden board. Your already muddled head now feels even worse.

You feel the cold wooden boards with your fingertips. The space around you is so narrow you can barely move. The air is stale, carrying the smell of damp, rotting wood. Strangely, this cramped space feels oddly familiar to you, as if you somehow know how to get out—

Holding your breath, you push against the wooden boards with all your strength. There's a "click" as a latch somewhere gives way. The boards immediately loosen and swing outward. A sliver of light seeps in, and cold air rushes into your lungs. At last, you have enough space to sit up.
[Castle Great Hall]

In the suffocating silence and dimness, faint moonlight spills through fractured stained-glass windows. The beams weave through crumbling antique furniture, casting twisted shadows over a floor strewn with rubble and dust. You don't recognize this place.
Looking down at where you were just lying, you realize—this isn't some wooden box, but a <color=#fb9259>coffin</color>.
Your coffin sits at the center of this unfamiliar hall. In the dimness, you can barely make out a line of small text engraved on the casket.
To Graves's true love—bound by an eternal vow.
